commit.message:
fix(motion): start the depth ladder one stepdown under Top Z (partial)

The shared level law cut_levels now starts at top - stepdown, so no
depth-stepping operation cuts a level at Top Z. The app's ladder_planes
calls the same law. Circular vault inner rings keep their opening plane.
The turning face drops a rung that stands on the top of the work.

Partial: about 40 motion tests still assume a level at Top Z and must be
restated or checked (list on the issue). App suites and goldens are not
run yet.

Refs #2004

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(motion): no vault ring at Top Z; restate the solid-law fixtures

The vault rim ring has its floor at Top Z and the first inner ring
opens there: both planes cut air, so a vault plane at Top Z is dropped
and a ring with no plane under Top Z is not walked.

The four solid-law tests assumed the air plane at Top Z. A blind hole,
a post ring or an overhang ring whose only legal level was Top Z is now
refused by name; the tests accept that refusal only where no ladder
level can fit, and keep every gouge and verify check on each path that
comes back. The prev-mask test measures the cut length, because the
move count differed only by the air plane. The new top_z_level pins
are green.

Refs #2004

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs(decisions): record the open Top Z findings of round 2

The material-top bite and the bore helix-transition rapid are open.

Refs #2004

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(motion): a bore-side transition starts over the top where no descent opened its column

The first helix transition of a bore contour whose entry was another arm
rapided down to the plane above. Its start disc reached 0.45 mm into the
uncut core over that plane (verify RapidInStock). The descent now starts
at the top of the cut plus the plunge height there.

Refs #2004

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(motion): keep the level at Top Z where stock stands over it

Approach gets the runtime field material_top. The app lays the setup's
stock top over it at generation and the pocket region planes read the
same top. cut_levels_under keeps the level at Top Z when material
stands over Top Z (the old ladder), so a bite never exceeds one
stepdown. Callers with links switch to the new law.

Refs #2004

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(motion): drop the Top Z air level from five level-count fixtures

center_cut_law, predrilled_entry, level_links and the rotary seam ring
counted the level at Top Z. Each expectation now counts the levels
under it. No assertion is loosened.

Refs #2004

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(motion): drop the Top Z air level from the round 4 fixtures

Each changed expectation counted a level at Top Z that cut only air
(the stock top, or the wrap skin). No gouge, verify, load or solid
check is loosened. The rotary height-window test pins the air-only
windows as refusals by name and keeps the station law on windows
that hold material (decision 8).

Refs #2004

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(motion): vertical arc entry has no arc at the Top Z air level

The entry arcs end at -2 and -4. Top Z 0 is the material top and no
longer a level. The recorded post inputs vertical_arc_*.cl are stale
and are not regenerated here.

Refs #2004

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(motion): trace and trochoidal slot read the material top

Trace, engrave and the trochoidal slot now take material_top and run
cut_levels_under, so with Top Z under the stock top the first level stays
at Top Z and no first bite is deeper than one stepdown. The app fills it
from the stock top in generate.rs. The three vertical_arc recordings lose
the air level at Top Z; the post test counts two arc blocks.

Refs #2004

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(app): trace and trochoidal slot keep Top Z under stock over it

A new app test generates a trace and a trochoidal slot with Top Z 2 mm
under the box stock top and pins the levels [18, 15, 12]. Decision item 9
records the material_top field on the two param types.

Refs #2004

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into issue/2004-top-z-level

test(app): regenerate goldens for the lost Top Z air level

Each regenerated golden loses only the level at Top Z (it cut air) and
its links. Read diffs:
- golden_cl: 12 files, one contiguous deletion each; circular_ring_arcs
  keeps its circles and its helix ramp now descends from the plunge
  height in one run (2.73 deg, under the 3.0 deg ramp angle).
- posted .nc goldens: one deletion hunk each (N numbers aside).
- adaptive trochoidal: the z 20 level is gone, z 17 stays.
- contour_bore_arc_entry: the first entry arc starts at the plunge
  height on the same circle.
- lathe facing (mm, css, inch): the rung at the work top is gone.
- thread mill M8, control and wear comp, tester kit microarc nc.

Fixtures:
- golden_cl face_square_40x40_stepped: 4 to 3 plunges.
- solid_law_goldens crossing list: the crossings of the lost level go.
- thread_boss: the rib top is 12 (was 16). With levels [15, 10] a rib
  over 15 makes the roughing refuse its first level; at 12 the roughing
  leaves the wall and the thread air law still refuses by name.

Moves emit_level to trochoid_level.rs (400-line law) and converts the
CRLF files of earlier rounds to LF.

Fixes #2004

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(motion): cut a shallow blind floor and name the picked-side refusal

Round 7 of #2004. The contour depth ladder searched a ring's floor only
under a level that the ring walked. With no air level at Top Z, a blind
hole shallower than one stepdown lost its floor pass. The floor search
now runs up to Top Z when the first level fails. picked_law runs before
the empty-ladder refusal, so the #1927 named refusal comes back.

Expectations that named only the lost Top Z level are updated: app
blind_floor, contour_outside_hole, drill_prior, post_engine slot golden
floor, the tormach explain goldens and the first-router-part example.
overhang_2d is back to the main version.

Refs #2004

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into issue/2004-top-z-level

test(app): drop the Top Z air level from the round 8 expectations

The 18 red app tests after round 7 each expected the old air level at
Top Z. Each one is class (a): the expectation is updated with a comment,
and no check is loosened. The two wrong-side contour refusals stay
refused and now assert the #1927 named text. The wall-arc entry tests
gain an assert that no entry rapids below the stock top.

Fixes #2004

test(motion): give main's trochoid shape-mask test its material top

The merge of main brought in a TrochoidParams literal without the
material_top field of #2004, so the motion test suite did not compile.
The test states no material above Top Z (material_top: None).

Fixes #2004

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge origin/main into issue/2004-top-z-level; keep the first rest level

Rest Adaptive (from main) called cut_levels, which no longer takes a
level at Top Z. The rest stock stands over the rest Top Z, so the rest
ladder now calls cut_levels_under with the stated material top, or
"over Top Z" when none is stated. examples/first-router-part.camproj
is regenerated with WRITE_GOLDEN=1 for main's stamp salt v3.

Pinned by adaptive::rest::tests::the_first_rest_level_at_top_z_is_cut_without_a_stated_material_top
and the rest_adaptive suite.

Two suites that main added kept the air level at Top Z: the rest

Merge origin/main into issue/2004-top-z-level (pocket.rs: level law moves to pocket_emit)

Main moved the pocket pass emission out of pocket_over into
pocket_emit::emit_pocket_passes (shared with rest2d). The PR's one
change in that block, cut_levels -> cut_levels_under with the stated
material top, now applies in emit_pocket_passes; pocket.rs takes
main's version. pocket_rest_corners.cl takes main's version here and
is regenerated in the next commit.

Both are regenerated with WRITE_GOLDEN=1 on the merged tree. The

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge origin/main (#2129) into issue/2004-top-z-level: two Approach fields

Main's #1559 field `Approach::material_top` (the carried stock, set only
where the entry dives into it) keeps its meaning and readers. This PR's
field is renamed `stock_top` (the setup's stock top, input of the level
law); every level-law reader, `TraceParams` and `TrochoidParams` follow.

Hand-resolved hunks:
- generate.rs: keep the `stock_top` line and main's carried_top!/carry_need!.
- project/approach.rs: both runtime fields default to None.
- contour_bore.rs bore_entry: main's entry_top() on the first engagement;
  this PR's `fresh` arm, which now also reads entry_top().

Refs #2004

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(app): lay the stock top over the #2129 entry fixture, as the generation does

The two later-region pins of top_stock_entry_tests generate with a bare
Links::PLANAR. Under the #2004 level law a missing stock top drops the
level at Top Z, so the first region never fed to Top. The generation sets
Approach::stock_top for every operation; the fixture now does the same
(the tall block's top, Z10). The assertions do not change.
